sloka: भक्ष्यन्ते राक्षसैः भीमैः नर मांसोपजीविभिः ।ते भक्ष्यमाणा मुनयो दण्डकारण्य वासिनः ॥३-१०-६॥
transliteration: bhakṣyante rākṣasaiḥ bhīmaiḥ nara māṁsopajīvibhiḥ ।te bhakṣyamāṇā munayo daṇḍakāraṇya vāsinaḥ ॥3-10-6॥

translations.english: The sages engrossed in various austerities in the forest have been victims to the dreadful demons living on human flesh.
